note: Content contract for the private Control Hub. build-controlhub.js renders it. metrics[].kind 'guardrail' tints the card blue; actions[].gate 'human' adds the Approve / Reject / Ask row; backlog[].status seeds TODO | DOING | DONE (the reader can cycle it, stored locally); questions[].feeds names the label the answer becomes.

seed.title: Seed state — no real numbers yet
seed.body: Metrics are placeholders until the system runs and you rate it over several weeks. Trends need time before they mean anything; this page shows the shape of what you will see.

backlogIntro.title: Your durable workbench
backlogIntro.body: The Coach appends 60-minute exercises on Fridays. Check items off and add notes during the week. Skippable by design — no weekly pressure, nothing expires.

actionsTakenEmpty: Nothing shipped yet. Approved actions land here with predicted vs actual impact, so the prescriber earns trust instead of asserting it.

metrics.name: Scout
metrics.measures: Recall — of items that mattered, how many were fetched
metrics.gradedBy: graded by: retrospective oracle + your "you missed X" feedback

metrics.name: Gatekeeper
metrics.gradedBy: graded by: your signal/noise ratings + Suppressed-drawer audit

metrics.name: Framer
metrics.gradedBy: graded by: claim decomposition (auto) + rubric ratings (you → LLM-judge)

metrics.name: Coach
metrics.gradedBy: graded by: repo assertions (auto) + your completion behavior

metrics.name: Tuner
metrics.measures: Slope of every other metric over time (meta-eval)
metrics.target: target: curves bending the right way
metrics.gradedBy: graded by: longitudinal trend, not level

metrics.name: Guardrail · Diversity
metrics.measures: Anti-echo-chamber. Stops the Tuner boosting ratings by only feeding what you already believe.
metrics.target: target: ≥ 20% of items outside your priors
metrics.gradedBy: protects: balancing your thinking with new thinking

When these collide on one weekend, rank them for DO THIS priority: MCP infra · RL technique · agentic-coding harness.

Ask Claude Code to make the first commit, then push
